G3.note: Scale confirmed by SEAB (G3 adopts the O-Level grading structure; GCE O-Level is treated as equivalent to G3 by MOE). Points = grade number is the long-standing O-Level aggregate convention; no SEC page restating the point values was seen, so treat the points column as provisional-by-convention. Certificate award: E8 or better at G3.

G2.note: Scale confirmed (G2 adopts N(A)-Level structure; N(A) treated as equivalent to G2). Points = grade number in ELMAB3 (ITE 2-year page computes aggregate from G2-equivalent grades directly). Certificate award: grade 5 or better. Grade 6 counts in ITE aggregates but cannot meet MERs.

G1.note: Points are the ITE aggregate points in the MOE 3-Year Higher Nitec mapping table. Certificate award: grade D or better. G1 E usable in ITE aggregate but not to meet MERs.

g2_in_g3_aggregate.rule: No G2-to-G3 up-mapping is published. Instead, mixed aggregates are computed in G2-equivalent points for the slot(s) allowed at G2. In ELR2B2 (poly, 2028+), EL, R1, R2 and B1 use the G3 grade (points 1-9 but 9 unusable); B2 ALWAYS uses a G2-equivalent grade: a G2 subject contributes its G2 grade (1-4 usable), a G3 subject in the B2 slot is mapped down with g3_to_g2_equivalent. G3 grade 9 and G2 grades 5 and 6 cannot be used in ELR2B2.
g2_in_g3_aggregate.l1r4: Not allowed: all L1R4 subjects (JC and MI) must be taken at G3.
g2_in_g3_aggregate.arts_lasalle: LASALLE 2028+: 4 non-English subjects, one may be G2; if all four are G3, the lowest-grade one is mapped G3->G2. Same shape as ELR2B2 R2B2 part.

mapping.same_subject_two_levels: If the same subject was taken at two levels, both are mapped and the better equivalent grade is used (ITE pages).

changes_since_2026_08_05.text: No new MOE press release, Parliamentary reply or SEAB notice changing PSE 2028 rules was found dated after 2026-08-05. MOE pages still say 2028-specific course information (CourseFinder MERs, aggregate-type lists) will be updated in mid-2027.

Corrections to app data found during verification (not new announcements): (1) poly B2 slot is always at G2-equivalent, not 'one of the two best may be G2'; (2) 22/24 are NET (after CCA) poly cut-offs; (3) JC/MI bonus cap is 3 (+2 LEP); (4) JC MTL can be G2 (1-5) or G1 (A-D); (5) ELR2B2 has 4 types A-D, no -E, and the app's family labels are wrong; (6) 3-year Higher Nitec uses G1-equivalent aggregate types, not G2; (7) G3 9 / G2 5-6 unusable in ELR2B2 and PFP ELMAB3 but usable in ITE aggregates.
Secondary explainers published Oct 2026 (edukatesg 6 Oct and 24 Oct 2026) restate the same rules; no changes.

open_questions: Definition of a 'G3 pass' for the Sec 5 '3 or more G3 passes' rule: not on any MOE page. SEAB calls A1 to C6 the O Level passes; the certificate is awarded at E8. Ask MOE or the school.
What applies to a JC or MI applicant with no Mother Tongue grade: not stated.
How many subject grade floors may be missed under conditional admission: not stated.
Which ITE courses use which G1 aggregate type (R2B2, R1B3-A/B/C, B4): not published; mid 2027.
2028 ELR2B2 relevant subject lists and per course MERs: mid 2027. MOE's own 2026 JAE table is used as provisional.

2028 PFP relevant subjects per cluster, including whether Physics, Chemistry and Biology count: mid 2027. The current list names only D&T, Nutrition and Food Science and the combined Sciences for the Sciences and DET clusters.
JC H2 prerequisites: MOE publishes none; each college sets its own.
Arts diploma length and how much the portfolio or audition weighs: not on any MOE page; institution pages not opened.

supersedes.text: JC and MI Humanities for R1 and R3: Bahasa Indonesia as a 3rd Language, Chinese (Special Programme), Malay (Special Programme), Geography, History, Higher Art, Higher Music, Humanities (Social Studies with an elective), Literature. Art, Music and Economics are 'Others' and count only as R4; so is Computing. Religious Knowledge cannot be counted.

Conditional admission to JC and MI continues from the 2028 PSE. With a subject grade floor missed: JC with L1R4 <= 12, or 13 to 16 with A1 or A2 in all four R subjects; MI with L1R4 <= 15, or 16 to 20 likewise. The grade must be obtained by the end of Year 1 (JC: otherwise transfer to Year 2 at MI). Not available for an Absent grade.
Mother Tongue and Higher Mother Tongue of the same language: only one may be used in any aggregate (JC, MI, polytechnic, PFP, ITE).
PFP, 2 year and 3 year Higher Nitec: CCA bonus points (Excellent 2, Good 1) are subtracted for posting. PFP 12 and Higher Nitec 19 are gross limits read before them.
ELMAB3 for PFP and 2 year Higher Nitec does not count G1 subjects. PFP also drops G2 5 and 6 and a G3 9; Higher Nitec counts them in the aggregate but not for subject MERs.
PFP subject minimums for the SEC cohort, at G2 level: English 3, Mathematics 3, relevant subject 3, two best subjects 4.

PFP has three clusters: Sciences; Design, Engineering and Technology; Humanities, Art, Media and Business. Design, and Engineering and Technology, are sub-clusters at NYP and TP only. Current relevant subjects for Sciences and DET: D&T, Food and Nutrition/Nutrition and Food Science, Science (Chemistry, Biology), Science (Physics, Biology), Science (Physics, Chemistry). For HAMB: Art, Geography, History, the three Humanities (Social Studies) combinations, Literature in English, Principles of Accounts. App ids: pfp_sciences, pfp_det, pfp_hamb.

Polytechnic R1 and R2 must be G3 subjects. For 2028 MOE states type B counts only Mathematics or Additional Mathematics as R1; MOE's 2026 JAE table prints one first group cell, Additional Mathematics and Mathematics, across B, C and D. A G2 Mathematics can only sit in B2.

Polytechnic types on MOE's 2026 JAE table. A: first group arts, business and humanities subjects without Principles of Accounts; second group adds Mathematics, Additional Mathematics, Mother Tongue and Higher Mother Tongue, D&T, Design Studies, Nutrition and Food Science, Principles of Accounts; no science in either. B: second group is Art, Business Studies, Combined Humanities, Economics, Geography, Higher Art, Higher Music, History, Humanities (Social Studies with an elective), Literature, Media Studies, Music, Principles of Accounts. C: second group is the sciences, Biotechnology, Computing, D&T, Nutrition and Food Science, Electronics, Exercise and Sports Science. D: second group is Art, Higher Art, the sciences, Biotechnology, Computing, D&T, Design Studies, Nutrition and Food Science, Electronics, Media Studies.

Arts institutions, one rule for both from the 2028 intake: a pass in G3 English at C6 or better, and 21 points or better in four other subjects (three G3 and one G2; with four G3, the lowest is mapped to G2). Admission tests, portfolios, auditions and interviews continue; meeting the minimum does not guarantee admission. Both are outside the PSE. Early admissions: LASALLE in May, NAFA in June, open to G2 and G3 students from AY2028.
NAFA Foundation Programme: ELMAB3 gross of 15 or better at G2 equivalent grades, excluding CCA bonus points.

Sec 5: not qualified for Polytechnic Year 1 means no course MER met or a net ELR2B2 of 23 or more. Students without enough G2 or G3 subjects to compute the criteria may consult their schools; eligible students approach their secondary school directly.

The PSE replaces the Joint Admissions Exercise, the PFP Admissions Exercise and the ITE Joint Intake Exercise (2 year and 3 year Higher Nitec). The DPP ceases from the AY2028 ITE intake. Up to 12 choices, six calendar days from the SEC results in mid January 2028, posting by early February 2028. Tie breakers: citizenship, choice order, gross aggregate, ballot.
G3 and G2 points equal the grade number: MOE's 2028 worked examples show it (for example 6 + 1 + 1 + 3 + 1 = 12).

A G2 subject cannot be R1 or R2: EL, R1, R2 and B1 use the G3 grade.
PFP ELMAB3 uses B1, B2 and B3.

NAFA's English requirement for 2028: MOE states G3 English at C6 for both institutions.
